mailbox_complete.acknowledge: Accept only sameissuer current OwnedTerminal; Completed after scoped finalizer ACK/counters verified; Incomplete never rewritten to Completed. Native journal persists only fixed private synthetic record, successful persist acknowledgment is separate channel ACK; failure or process loss =>unverified, no work result SUCCESS/fake stopped acknowledgment.
